current.text: Dunn projects as the Clippers' sixth man. He could also start.
He is useful for fantasy only if he starts and plays about 28 minutes.
The Clippers may treat this as a trial season with long rotations and many players tested. Lue also often changes his rotations, so Dunn's minutes may be unstable.
The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in our fantasy playoff weeks. They have 13 back-to-backs, one of the lowest totals in the league.

durable.text: He is a stable, elite defender who gets a lot of steals and adds a few assists.
He is a low-usage player who scores little and makes few threes.

note: Yahoo ranks him 191 and ESPN 184, and both price him at 0 USD. That puts him outside the 144 players our league drafts, so do not spend auction money on him. His value is steals (1.4 projected) and few turnovers, but at 6.2 points and 0.9 threes per game he gives little else. Early in the season, check whether he moves into the starting five and plays about 28 minutes. If he does, he is a waiver pickup for teams that need steals, and his 4-3-4 playoff schedule helps.
